sourceOfTruth.requirement: Drain complete stdout JSON before exiting, including typed failures; preserve exit semantics; all 6 freshness cases pass.

inputs: JSON payload bytes (ASCII and escaped multibyte UTF-8)
stdout sink: child_process.spawnSync pipe or regular file descriptor
exit class: success 0, typed halt 1, CLI exception 2
CLI entry: packet, branch, realizations, context-table, worktree
packet step: prepare, validate, implement, green, verify
freshness: unchanged, AC changed, inputs changed, remote head moved, live AC re-read, no inline Status
consumers: Direct CLI readers via native Node spawnSync
classes: Success packets for all 5 dispatched steps x all 3 styles x both representations
Exact 8191/8192/8193-byte envelopes and a 65536-byte envelope x both representations
Small/large typed halt and CLI exception x both representations
Large regular-file output control x both representations
Small context-table/realizations and worktree validation control x both representations
Bridge packet success (slash/instruction) and small/large typed refusal x both representations
interactions: Producer stdout lifetime x kernel pipe capacity x JSON parser
Typed refusal termination x queued stdout x bridge error propagation
Packet stage x style x large payload x representation
Freshness trigger x verify packet x real bridge x stub engine
equivalenceRationale: emit is private and the module executes its CLI on import; the actual CLI is its authoritative executable interface, not an imported twin.
Transport owns the emitted bytes and exit status; downstream workflow transition semantics stay unchanged.
Worktree validation control exercises its CLI without creating worktrees or reaching a tracker; large success bytes are independently covered at the same emitter by branch and packet.
inventory.authority: Review finding r1-2 at f8fc1f49040add615e456d537f6e0394089e9c72; complete parseable packets required across the actual Node spawnSync boundary.
